title: Comfort Club Reinstatement Fee and the Length of the Lapse
content:
Under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements, the reinstatement fee follows how long the agreement stood lapsed. The lapse days are the calendar days from the lapsed term's last day to the date of handling: a term ending 31 May reinstated on 7 June has 7 lapse days.

## Lapse rule
| Lapse days | Lapse-adjusted fee |
|---|---|
| 7 or fewer (no more than the waiver days of 7) | No reinstatement fee is charged |
| More than 7 and no more than 30 (the standard days) | The tier's reinstatement fee as it stands |
| More than 30 | The tier's reinstatement fee multiplied by the lapse days, divided by 30, and rounded up to the next whole dollar |

"Rounded up to the next whole dollar" means any fraction of a dollar is raised to the next whole dollar; a result that is already a whole dollar stays as it is.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier fee of 25.00)

| Lapse days | Working | Lapse-adjusted fee |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | within the waiver days | 0.00 |
| 8 | fee as it stands | 25.00 |
| 30 | fee as it stands | 25.00 |
| 31 | 25.00 multiplied by 31, divided by 30, is 25.83, raised to 26.00 | 26.00 |
| 44 | 25.00 multiplied by 44, divided by 30, is 36.67, raised to 37.00 | 37.00 |
| 36 | 25.00 multiplied by 36, divided by 30, is exactly 30.00 | 30.00 |

## Boundary points
- Day 7 itself carries no fee; day 8 carries the tier fee.
- Day 30 carries the tier fee unchanged; from day 31 the fee grows with the lapse.
